title: AudioStreamInteractive "no fade" transitions leave prior clip running
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.1.limboai+v1.7.0.gha [14d19694e]

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.limboai+v1.7.0 (14d19694e) - macOS Tahoe (26.3.1) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Apple M2 Max - Apple M2 Max (12 threads) - 32.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

The AudioStreamInteractive transitions, when `Fade` is set to `Disabled`, do not stop the prior clip when the prior clip is imported as a looping audio clip.  Instead, the clip continues to play while the new clip also plays.

### Steps to reproduce

Create an AudioStreamInteractive with two clips, both using WAV imported with looping set to `Forward`.
Specify a transition in the ASI Transition Editor for Clip1 -> Clip2 with `Fade Mode` set to `Disabled`.
Add something to trigger the transition to the scene.

When the transition happens, the Clip1 continues playing even while Clip2 plays.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[audio-interactive-transition-loop-fade.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26259030/audio-interactive-transition-loop-fade.zip)

Scene "with fade" has the transition fade set to "Automatic".  This behaves "as expected".
Scene "without fade" has the transition fade set to "Disabled".  This leaves the previous clip playing.

### WORKAROUND

If the `Fade` is set to `Cross-Fade` with the `Fade Beats` set to `0`, then the behavior is as expected - this might suffice for most usecases.
